statements.t: Daniel Virnich, CEO of Starling, commented, "The third quarter of 2026 was another strong quarter for our company, with revenue up 24% year over year and Adjusted EBITDA of $3.4 million, our second consecutive quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA and above our third quarter outlook of $0.50 million to $1.5 million.
Based on our performance year to date, we are affirming our full-year 2026 guidance, and we believe we are well positioned for continued growth into 2027."
For the fourth quarter of 2026, we anticipate Adjusted EBITDA** of $3 million to $5 million, as the Company onboards and ramps our Florida delegated lives.
The Company expects approximately $110 million in capitated revenue in 2026.

The Company also anticipates that Medical Loss Ratio, discussed under “Financial Information; Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below, will be in the range of 85% to 90% in 2027 with the onboarding of new lives.
The outlook information included in this press release represents management's current estimates as of the date of this release.
